title: Diagnose Codex CLI incomplete local package error
description: Identify why invoking codex reports that the CLI has no complete local package and provide the corrective action.
notes:
Diagnosed codex 0.159.2 startup: PATH resolves to llm-agents.nix's source-built binary at /etc/profiles/per-user/ct/bin/codex. That derivation installs only bin/{codex,codex-code-mode-host,logs_client} and completions. New daemon startup requires a packaged layout rooted by codex-package.json plus bin/codex, bin/codex-code-mode-host, and codex-path/rg. No codex-package.json means InstallContext.package_layout=None and startup emits the exact error. codex --no-daemon works.
Verified Homebrew cask codex 0.159.2 is not installed. Its URL is the official complete codex-package-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz, unlike the Nix source build. Repo currently installs llmAgents.codex unconditionally in nix/features/common.nix:206, so Darwin resolves the incomplete Nix package first. Recommended immediate workaround: --no-daemon. Durable Darwin fix: install Homebrew cask codex and remove/condition llmAgents.codex to non-Darwin.

description: Inspect existing Git maintenance and cc-notify LaunchAgents plus local mise worktree; research macOS-native and existing tool options; recommend a scoped approach without implementing migration.
notes: Assessment complete; no service/code changes or host apply. Read both Nix modules, host declarations/spec, tracked Git config, local mise worktree preview README/config and mise skill. Verified vendored mise docs/bootstrap/{launchd,services}.md, docs/bootstrap.md and src/system/launchd.rs plus custom-command mapping in user_services.rs; web research corroborates primary mise/Git/Homebrew docs. Recommend macOS-native launchd declarations through mise; retain small repo-specific preparation and filtered Git maintenance script. cc-notify maps directly to program/args/working_directory/run_at_load/keep_alive/log paths. Important: raw LaunchAgents phase precedes tool install and final bootstrap task; prepare tools/checkout/deps/logs before applying agents. mise exec must load a durable global/project config; launchd lacks interactive shell env. Remove old com.codethread jobs before new dev.mise jobs; removing TOML declarations does not prune installed agents. No installed mise on host PATH, so assessment is docs/source verified, not runtime tested.
